item.title: Emeka Egbuka: Practicing in regular jersey
item.description:
Egbuka (concussion/foot) is wearing a regular jersey at Thursday's practice, suggesting he has been cleared for contact, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Jeffery Simmons: Traded to Chicago
item.description:
Simmons was traded to the Bears on Thursday, along with a 2028 fifth-round pick, in exchange for first-round picks in 2027 and 2028, as well as a 2027 fourth-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Expected to play against Titans
item.description:
Chase (ankle) isn't believed to be dealing with a serious injury, and he's expected to suit up Sunday against the Titans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Matthew Golden: Optimism for Thursday availability
item.description:
The Packers expect Golden (shoulder/foot), who is listed as questionable for Thursday night's game against the Panthers, to suit up, James Palmer of NFL on Prime Video reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Lamar Jackson: On track to play Sunday
item.description:
Jackson (ankle) handled all of the first-team work during Wednesday's practice and is on track to play Sunday against the Bills, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
